profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Dynamic software engineer with over 10 years of experience in software development, code implementation, and system integration. Demonstrated success in unit testing and analysis. Adept at identifying code defects, promptly designing resolution strategies and performing corrective measures. Skilled in accurate documentation and reporting. Proven collaborator, teaming with colleagues on large-scale projects to surpass expectations in achieving objectives.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Designed and implemented the backend web services API of a mobile POS application for retail customers based on their legacy desktop POS systems, using core Java, Guice, Spark and AOP. Integrated with Verifone E285/E355 payment devices and payment providers such as Fipay, ACI and Adyen. Worked and collaborated with QA team to ensure that functionalities are tested from end to end and to resolve software defects.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant III
positions.description: Developed new and/or modified existing features of a Retail POS desktop application using Java, Spring, XML, and HTML to meet client’s business requirements. Developed and enhanced mobile POS using JAX-WS for back-end web server and Objective-C for mobile client iOS app. Worked with clients and internal team members to provide technical support and consulting. Worked with Quality Assurance personnel to research and resolve software problems. Implemented technical designs in accordance with established programming and technical standards. Worked closely with Project Management and Quality Assurance in the development process to bring projects to successful conclusion.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained embedded systems for home or office printers, using C/C ++ during firmware development lifecycle. Designed and implemented code on CentOS platform. Utilized numerous tools to efficiently achieve project objectives, including Git, SVN, and SlickEdit. Contributed to Agile Scrum development team. Conducted firmware unit and integration testing. Reviewed code and ensured accuracy and desired outcomes. Collaborated with Assessment & Quality Control teams to isolate and resolve firmware defects.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Worked on numerous development projects for POS application utilizing various tools, including PC-Lint and SourceOffsite. Designed, implemented, and maintained utility software in Visual C++. Developed Perl scripts used in retail POS device installation, configuration, and firmware updates. Created software test plans & conducted unit testing on software modules. Presented technical documentation for software updates and designed document and code reviews.

projects.title: Online Banking Application
projects.description:
Designed and developed online banking application with security mechanisms; simple web application for secure online banking.

Technologies used: Java, JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MS SQL Server 2008, ODBC, JDBC, Apache Tomcat.
